# tap command

Add a `tap` command that jumps into a Homebrew tap's checkout:

```bash
$ tap kamilsk
# cd /usr/local/Homebrew/Library/Taps/kamilsk/...
```

The author maintains their own tap (`kamilsk/tap`, later `octolab/tap`), and editing a formula means finding it under Homebrew's `Library/Taps`, whose prefix differs between Intel and Apple Silicon.
